summary: Four Major proof-dependency findings (P1,P2,P3,P5) and one Minor correction group (P4) in the 86-page ORA AAM. No counterexample to the principal theorem and no complete Type I/II repair claimed.

problems.title: Joint prime-ideal constraints invalidate Lemma9.5 constant
problems.assumptions: K=Q(zeta5), integral basis 1,zeta5,zeta5²,zeta5³; m=1,I=O_K; standard ideal Mobius.
problems.check: At p11 roots3,4,5,9. Full enumeration1331 triples yields subset counts1331,121,11,1,1. rho((11))=11 whereas rho(each degree1prime)=1. Joint Mobius factor910/1331 versus10000/14641, ratio1001/1000. Splitting types in the cyclic quartic field Q(zeta5) yield extra factors1+(p-1)^-3 for1111,1+(p-1)/(p?-1)? for22,1 for4/ramified. All>=1, product converges, strict >1. Abelian F(1+u)=u? integral_1^infty S(R)R^(-u-1)dR contradicts claimed S limit using zeta residue.
problems.result: Strict counterexample to the constant of Lemma9.5, not to Lemma9.4 under its norm-coprime hypothesis.
problems.counterevidence: A rational-prime joint-factor reorganization may preserve intended cancellation; final Theorems1.1/4.1 not refuted.
problems.impact: Normalization of approximation weights and TypeI main term depends on the erroneous factorization.
problems.correction: Use joint factors grouped by rational primes. Explicit replacement known for m=1,I=O_K; full uniform m,I and h(J)/TypeI reconstruction remains unproved here.
problems.repair_verification: Partial only; exact counterexample and constant discrepancy established.
problems.acceptance_terminology_correction: Replaced inaccurate C5 splitting-type label with cyclic quartic field Q(zeta5), whose Galois group is C4; the actual field, roots and calculation are unchanged.

problems.result: Published explicit choice does not establish displayed saving; replacement feasible for enumerated constraints.
problems.counterevidence: No general infeasibility of proof parameters; replacement passes.
problems.impact: The half-to-quarter substitution occurs in the actual derivation of S1=o(X) on p34 and hence the proof of Proposition 3.3. The supplied replacement satisfies the enumerated explicit inequalities but does not make the original core derivation a Minor error.
problems.correction: Use correct theta22 bound and replacement parameters in report; implicit later choices not certified.
problems.repair_verification: Explicit Eqs6.2-6.9/Lemma7.1/correctedSection7/Lemma8.1 conditions verified. Eq6.9 has no square; helper's earlier squared reading corrected separately.
problems.acceptance_severity_correction: Minor to Major after tracing Proposition 3.3 dependence; no general parameter infeasibility or final-theorem counterexample asserted.

independent_acceptance_check.result: Confirmed core exponent error; severity corrected.
independent_acceptance_check.source_locator: AAM p.28 (6.2)?(6.9) and explicit parameters; p.30 Lemma7.1; p.34 final S1 derivation; p.35 Lemma8.1.
independent_acceptance_check.hypotheses: The valid upper exponent is theta22<=(1+alpha0)/2-theta21; eta0>alpha0 and theta0>0. All other explicit parameter restrictions must also hold.

Original alpha=1e-5 forces RHS>0.01674, greater than theta21=.001. The exact rational replacement alpha=1e-7,tau=theta0=1e-10,eta=1.01e-7 with original theta values gives positive stated margins; (6.9) has no square. problems.title: Cofactor discriminant formulas
problems.source_location: AAM p25 Lemma5.14; p26 Eq5.29 andLemma5.16; associated boundary pp26,35-36
problems.assumptions: General monic quartic coefficients c0..c3 and cofactor B14; q3 from Eq5.10; root pairing as in manuscript.
problems.check: Independent companion matrix gives Delta14=-q3*h with a2² coefficient -c3², and h=-(c3²-4t2)q3-4q2. Exact symbolic residuals zero. Correct h retains5.29 under full odd-prime coprimality/squarefree assumptions.
problems.result: Two printed identity errors with explicit corrected polynomial.
problems.counterevidence: Correct formula preserves intended local zero tests, including distinct one-root branch; does not invalidate all downstream algebra.
problems.impact: Local algebra correction. Separate even-quartic branch inconsistency recorded with uncompleted weighted repair.
problems.correction: Replace displayed h and factorization as in report. P=x4+2 has t1=t2=0, refutes t1!=0 remark and shows why p36 universal rootcount2 needs kappa_p=1or2. Local lowerbound1-kappa/p>=1-2/p does not complete globalerrorproof.
problems.repair_verification: Discriminant identity corrected; entire Lemma8.1 asymptotic neither refuted by a full J tuple nor completely repaired.

independent_acceptance_check.result: Confirmed local discriminant corrections and restricted degenerate branch conflict.
independent_acceptance_check.source_locator: AAM p.25 Lemma5.14; p.26 (5.29), Lemma5.16 and remark; p.36 CRT root count.
independent_acceptance_check.hypotheses: General monic quartic/cofactor conventions as given; zero tests need odd primes with the complete coprimality and squarefree hypotheses. T^4+2 is within the allowed D4 polynomial class.
independent_acceptance_check.decisive_check: The multiplication companion matrix and cofactor discriminant give Delta14=-q3*h with coefficient -c3?*a2? and h=-(c3?-4t2)q3-4q2. The root substitution still gives (5.29). For the allowed even quartic paired opposite roots, t1=t2=0, contradicting the nonzero remark and making the q2 branch have one root while p.36 uses two.
independent_acceptance_check.counterevidence: The corrected algebra preserves the actual local zero tests. No subsequent division by t1 was found, and no tuple satisfying every asymptotic J/weight condition was established as a counterexample to Lemma8.1.
independent_acceptance_check.repair_scope: Correct the polynomial identities and use kappa_p in {1,2}; the lower bound 1-kappa_p/p>=1-2/p is only a possible local route, not a completed global weighted-error repair.

problems.title: Incorrect asymptotic normalization in the Type I main term
problems.source_location: AAM p66 Eq10.22; p64 Lemma10.2; p59 Proposition9.13; pp60?61 Eqs9.28?9.30; Theorem4.1 p11 has correct final log
problems.check: Partial summation gives 2log(logP2/logP1)/phi(Df)=2log(tauprime/tau)/phi(Df), not 2log(P2/P1)/phi(Df). Actual formula images viewed.
problems.result: Incorrect intermediate normalization; final Theorem4.1 already has correct logarithm.
problems.counterevidence: No final theorem constant counterexample from this typo. Formal finite g(mprime) cancellation possible after respecting coprimality, but P1 obstructs treating prime-local telescope as global repair.
problems.impact: Printed log(P2/P1) has an extra order logX. It is propagated through Lemma10.2 and Proposition9.13 into the proof of Theorem4.1, a core invalid derivation. Correct final log is retained as counterevidence; no false final-theorem constant is inferred.
problems.correction: Correct intermediate logarithms; rework full localfactor calculation underP1.
problems.repair_verification: Reciprocal-prime mainterm correction exact; not a completed TypeI repair.
problems.acceptance_severity_correction: Minor to Major for a core Type I derivation; explicit partial-summation correction is not a full Type I repair under P1.

independent_acceptance_check.result: Confirmed wrong Type I main-term order; severity corrected.
independent_acceptance_check.source_locator: AAM p.59 Proposition9.13; p.60 (9.28); p.61 (9.30); p.64 Lemma10.2; p.66 (10.22); correct final Theorem4.1 p.11.
independent_acceptance_check.hypotheses: P1=X^tau,P2=X^tauprime for fixed positive tau<tauprime, fixed progression modulus Df, np=2+O(1/p).
independent_acceptance_check.decisive_check: Partial summation gives sum np/p = (2/phi(Df))log(logP2/logP1)+o(1) = (2/phi(Df))log(tauprime/tau)+o(1). The printed log(P2/P1) instead grows as logX. Direct source reading confirms its propagation through Lemma10.2, Proposition9.13 and (9.28)?(9.30), which the text explicitly uses to derive Theorem4.1.
independent_acceptance_check.counterevidence: Theorem4.1 itself already has the correct log(tauprime/tau), so this finding is not a false final-constant counterexample. Formal finite local factors may cancel after respecting exclusions.
independent_acceptance_check.repair_scope: Correct the reciprocal-prime normalization throughout the actual derivation; P1 prevents treating prime-local telescoping as a complete Type I repair.

independent_acceptance_scope.result: All five existing groups were independently checked. P1/P2 remain Major; P3 and P5 are corrected from Minor to Major after tracing their actual use in Proposition 3.3 and the Type I derivation of Theorem 4.1. P4 remains Minor with its local algebra, branch, and uncompleted weighted-repair limits. Corrected inaccurate C5 wording to the cyclic quartic field Q(zeta5). No principal-theorem counterexample or complete Type I/II repair is claimed.
counterevidence_and_severity_basis: P1 refutes the printed global auxiliary constant using a genuine Abelian consequence, not only a local Euler-factor mismatch.
P2 refutes actual intermediate uniform index and primitivity implications; weight-support and averaged-bound limitations remain explicit.
P3's exponent substitution is used to prove the required S1=o(X) saving; P5's logarithm has the wrong asymptotic order in a central Type I main term. Both are Major despite plausible corrections.
P4's corrected discriminant retains the actual zero test; the even-quartic root branch is a bounded local conflict without a full admissible J tuple or completed weighted analysis.
